description: This file defines a routing strategy class 'LowestLatencyLoggingHandler' that manages latency-based routing for models in a machine learning deployment environment. It includes methods for logging success and failure events, computing available deployments based on latency metrics, and selecting the lowest latency deployment within a specified buffer. It also defines a 'RoutingArgs' configuration class for timeout and buffer parameters.

classes.name: RoutingArgs
classes.description: Configuration class for routing parameters such as TTL, latency buffer, and maximum latency list size.
